guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 沿閘室節水池水量能量與誤差收支檢查回用機制。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Examine lock-basin reuse through chamber water, energy and uncertainty balances. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設直壁閘室面積3000m²、升差10m且浮船排水量不變，ΔV=AΔh=30000m³；未計漏水與進出船交換。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設閘室3000m²在10m、池6000m²在4m，zf=(3000×10+6000×4)/9000=6m，轉移水量12000m³。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設水1000kg/m³、兩池面積3000與6000m²、初水位差6m，耗散E=ρg[A1A2/(A1+A2)]Δh²/2=353.16MJ。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設同一循環總交換30000m³、池回用18000m³，r=60%，外部補水12000m³；此60%不是與其他尺寸船閘的差額。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設持續漏水0.020m³/s維持86400s，日損失Qt=1728m³；僅在漏水率固定時成立，不能由此指定現場允許值。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設總水面12000m²、當日蒸發深0.005m，損失AE=60m³/day；不是每次通航都損失60m³。
factsEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume a vertical-wall chamber area3000m²,lift10m and unchanged floating displacement. ΔV=AΔh=30000m³, excluding leakage and vessel-entry exchange.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume chamber3000m² at10m and basin6000m² at4m. Final zf=6m by area weighting, transferring12000m³ with no external flows.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume water1000kg/m³,areas3000 and6000m² and initial head difference6m. Dissipated E=ρg[A1A2/(A1+A2)]Δh²/2=353.16MJ without recovery.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume one cycle exchanges30000m³ and reuses18000m³. Reuse is60% and external supply12000m³;60% is not a comparison with another lock size.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume constant leakage0.020m³/s for86400s. Daily loss Qt=1728m³; the assumption does not specify an allowable field leakage rate.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume exposed water area12000m² and daily evaporation depth0.005m. Loss AE=60m³/day, not60m³ for every lockage.
timeline: 2006　工兵團發布船閘水理設計手冊版本
2016　巴拿馬節水池試驗與擴建運河啟用
2018　工兵團發布船閘廊道閥門水理手冊
timelineEn: 2006 — USACE publishes its navigation-lock hydraulic design manual
2016 — Panama tests water-saving basins and inaugurates the expanded canal
2018 — USACE publishes hydraulic guidance for lock culvert valves
codes: 船閘廊道閥門水理EM1110-2-1610，二〇一八年
codesEn: Hydraulic Design of Navigation Locks EM1110-2-1604,2006
Hydraulic Design of Lock Culvert Valves EM1110-2-1610,2018
landmarks: 阿瓜克拉拉船閘節水池
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：閘室節水池設計
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Water-saving basins for lock chambers
guides.concept: 節水池不是單純多建一個水槽，而是把不同高程的儲水與閘室循環連結。十個單元依序檢查幾何水量、等水位交換、位能耗散、比例分母、持續漏損、蒸發、廊道流量、交換時間、量測偏差及池體停用。所有算例均為明示假設，讓學徒能從水量與能量兩條證據鏈辨認不合理績效宣稱。
guides.conceptEn: Water-saving basins link storage at different elevations with the lock cycle rather than merely adding a tank. Ten units examine geometric demand, equalization, energy loss, denominators, leakage, evaporation, culvert flow, timing, measurement bias and basin outages. Declared synthetic examples give apprentices separate water and energy evidence for detecting misleading performance claims.
procedure: 船閘升降所需水量由有效水面面積與水位差決定，應先分清閘室、廊道與相連池體的控制範圍。浮船排水量若全程不變，在兩個水位狀態相減時會抵銷，不能重複扣除；不規則岸壁、跨室進出船及漏水則需要額外收支。 假設直壁閘室面積3000m²、升差10m且浮船排水量不變，ΔV=AΔh=30000m³；未計漏水與進出船交換。
節水池與閘室連通後由水頭差驅動交換，若無其他流出入，最後水位可由體積守恆求得。不同面積的池體不是水位簡單平均，連通管只影響達到平衡的速度而不改變理想最終值；實際還需辨認未排盡廊道、漏水與截止閥提前關閉。 假設閘室3000m²在10m、池6000m²在4m，zf=(3000×10+6000×4)/9000=6m，轉移水量12000m³。
重力交換可回收水量但仍耗散位能，節水不等於能量無損傳遞。以共同基準計算水體位能並相減，可以分辨可用水頭和摩擦耗散；固定面積及靜止端點的理想式不含水面振盪、外部泵浦或發電回收，因此不能直接用作機組功率預測。 假設水1000kg/m³、兩池面積3000與6000m²、初水位差6m，耗散E=ρg[A1A2/(A1+A2)]Δh²/2=353.16MJ。
節水績效必須指定基準循環、總交換量與外部補水來源，否則不同船閘大小的百分比無法直接比較。回用比例是本系統內的水量分配，和比舊船閘少用多少水屬不同問題；漏水、蒸發、鹽度控制或不同通航組合還會改變實際外部取水。 假設同一循環總交換30000m³、池回用18000m³，r=60%，外部補水12000m³；此60%不是與其他尺寸船閘的差額。
節水池停用時仍可能因接縫或閥座漏水損失，這是持續時間問題，不能只按通航次數估算。日總量與每次循環用水需分開，且漏水隨水頭變化不一定恆定；將靜態保水觀測與運轉期間收支結合，才能判斷未解釋的補水量是否來自同一機制。 假設持續漏水0.020m³/s維持86400s，日損失Qt=1728m³；僅在漏水率固定時成立，不能由此指定現場允許值。
增設節水池增加可儲水量，也擴大暴露水面，日蒸發需與降雨和通航節水分開核算。實際蒸發受氣象、水溫及遮蔽影響，不能把區域年平均直接當任一日；面積計算則應依水位變動，分清池底占地和當時有效水面。 假設總水面12000m²、當日蒸發深0.005m，損失AE=60m³/day；不是每次通航都損失60m³。
連通初期水頭差較大，流量會隨兩池水位接近而降低，固定孔口式只代表某個瞬間。閥門開度、進出口和廊道損失都會影響等效係數，慣性與水面振盪則超出準穩態模型；單一初始流量不可直接乘整段時間宣稱填池完成。 假設等效Cd=0.70、開口4m²、水頭差2m，Q=Cd a√(2gΔh)=17.54m³/s；僅作瞬時準穩態示意。

計算交換時間需同時更新兩個池水位，面積較小的一側變化較快，因而水頭衰減不是固定斜率。準穩態積分可到指定殘餘水頭，但接近等水位時慣性和閥門控制會更重要；模型只能提供辨識尺度，不能替實際控制系統設定關閥時刻。 假設固定池面積A1=3000、A2=6000m²、a=4m²、Cd=0.7，k=Cd a√(2g)(1/A1+1/A2)；水頭差Δh由6降0.1m，準穩態時間t=2(√6−√0.1)/k=688.0s。
大面積節水池的水位微小偏差會轉成顯著方量，更多讀值不能自動消除共同零點誤差。位準轉換、儀器漂移及水面擺動應分別處理，庫容曲線亦需適用目前幾何；這項誤差可能使回用績效看似改善，卻沒有真正降低外部補水。 假設固定水面6000m²、共同水位偏差0.010m，庫容偏差Aδz=60m³；此系統偏差不隨讀值數增加自動消失。
池體檢修或連通失效會改變可達回用率，外部補水增加幅度並不等於回用率減少的百分點。水源調度還受每日通航、庫存和其他用途限制，不能假設取水可無限補足；比較情境時應固定總交換需求，再清楚列出缺少哪些路徑。 假設每循環30000m³，回用率由0.60降0.40，外部補水由12000升18000m³，增加50%；非只增加20%。
procedureEn: Lift volume follows the effective waterplane area and level change after defining chamber, culverts and connected basins. A freely floating vessel with unchanged displacement cancels between the two states and must not be deducted twice. Irregular walls, vessel entry or departure and leakage require additional accounting rather than silently modifying the geometric calculation. Assume a vertical-wall chamber area3000m²,lift10m and unchanged floating displacement. ΔV=AΔh=30000m³, excluding leakage and vessel-entry exchange.

Head difference drives exchange between chamber and basin. Without external flow, volume conservation gives the final level, weighted by surface areas rather than a simple mean. Culvert resistance affects the approach to equilibrium rather than its ideal endpoint. Real assessments must additionally identify trapped culvert volumes, leakage and valves closing before equalization is complete. Assume chamber3000m² at10m and basin6000m² at4m. Final zf=6m by area weighting, transferring12000m³ with no external flows.

Gravity exchange can reuse water while dissipating potential energy, so saving water does not imply lossless energy transfer. Differencing storage potential on one datum separates available head from dissipation. The fixed-area model assumes resting endpoints and excludes surface oscillation, external pumps and energy recovery, so it cannot directly predict the output of an installed generating unit. Assume water1000kg/m³,areas3000 and6000m² and initial head difference6m. Dissipated E=ρg[A1A2/(A1+A2)]Δh²/2=353.16MJ without recovery.

Performance needs a defined cycle, gross exchange and external supply, otherwise percentages from different lock sizes are not directly comparable. Reuse fraction describes internal allocation, whereas reduced water demand relative to an older lock is a different comparison. Leakage, evaporation, salt-control flushing and vessel scheduling can further change actual withdrawal beyond the nominal fraction. Assume one cycle exchanges30000m³ and reuses18000m³. Reuse is60% and external supply12000m³;60% is not a comparison with another lock size.

Leakage through joints or seats can continue while a basin is idle, making duration as important as lockage count. Daily loss and cycle demand require separate reporting, and leakage may vary with head. Combining static retention observations with operational balances helps determine whether unexplained makeup water follows the same mechanism rather than assuming a fixed loss per vessel. Assume constant leakage0.020m³/s for86400s. Daily loss Qt=1728m³; the assumption does not specify an allowable field leakage rate.

Additional basins provide storage while expanding exposed surface area. Daily evaporation must be accounted for separately from rainfall and lockage savings. Weather, water temperature and shelter affect evaporation, so a regional annual average is not a value for every day. Area should follow changing levels, distinguishing the basin footprint from its actual water surface. Assume exposed water area12000m² and daily evaporation depth0.005m. Loss AE=60m³/day, not60m³ for every lockage.

Initial head difference drives a larger flow that falls as levels converge, so a fixed-orifice relation describes one instant. Valve position, entrances and culvert losses determine the effective coefficient, while inertia and surface oscillation lie outside the quasi-steady model. Initial discharge cannot simply be multiplied by the entire exchange duration to establish completion. Assume effective Cd=0.70,opening4m² and head difference2m. Q=Cd a√(2gΔh)=17.54m³/s is an instantaneous quasi-steady illustration.

Exchange-time calculation updates both levels, with the smaller area moving faster so head does not decay linearly. A quasi-steady integral can reach a specified residual head, but inertia and valve control become important near equality. The result provides a diagnostic timescale rather than a command for closing a real valve or authorizing an operating sequence. Assume areas3000,6000m²,opening4m²,Cd=0.7. With k=Cd a√(2g)(1/A1+1/A2), reducing head6to0.1m takes t=2(√6−√0.1)/k=688.0s.

A small level bias over a large basin produces substantial storage error, and more readings do not remove a shared zero offset. Datum conversion, instrument drift and surface oscillation require separate treatment, as does the validity of the current storage curve. Such error can create apparent improvement in reuse while external makeup demand remains unchanged. Assume fixed area6000m² and coherent level bias0.010m. Storage bias Aδz=60m³; additional readings do not automatically eliminate this systematic error.

Maintenance or a failed connection changes achievable reuse, and the percentage increase in makeup is not the percentage-point drop in reuse. Supply also depends on traffic, stored water and other demands, so unlimited replacement withdrawal cannot be assumed. Scenario comparison must hold gross exchange fixed while identifying missing pathways and any additional operational constraints. Assume gross exchange30000m³ per cycle. Reuse falls0.60to0.40; makeup rises12000to18000m³, a50% increase rather than20%.
evidence: 畫出兩端水位與所有連通界面，核對面積是否隨高程改變。將同一船舶兩狀態排水量相減，獨立列廊道及漏水項，再用水位時間序列積分對照流量，避免重複扣掉船體體積。
把兩個水位轉成相同基準，列出各自高程與儲量曲線並核對連通狀態。以兩端水位變化各算一次交換體積，追查差額的時間位置，不能用任意修改池面積吸收漏水或量測偏差。
分別積分初末兩池的重力位能，檢查使用相同零高程及總水量。將中途動能、外部供能與可能回收分項列示，驗證能量差的去向，不把整段能量除任意時間就當設備額定功率。
在報表中同時列出分子、分母、循環定義與船舶配置，保持比較時段一致。另記漏水和沖淡鹽分所用水，逐項核對外部取水表，避免把名義回用量當成整個流域實際節水。
在無進出水且水頭已知的時段追蹤池位，扣除降雨蒸發及量測偏差，再推估漏水。比較不同水頭的資料並標明觀測時長，避免將整天缺水全歸因於某一閥件。
evidenceEn: Draw both levels and every connected boundary, checking whether area varies with elevation. Difference the vessel displacement between states, list culverts and leakage separately, and compare integrated flow with level records without subtracting the whole hull volume twice.

Reference both levels to one datum and document elevation-storage curves and connections. Calculate transferred volume independently from each side, investigating when the mismatch appears instead of changing the basin area arbitrarily to conceal leakage or measurement bias.

Integrate initial and final potential energy for both basins using one origin and total water quantity. List transient kinetic energy, external input and any recovery separately, explaining the difference rather than dividing it by an arbitrary time to claim rated machinery power.

Report numerator, denominator, cycle definition and vessel configuration for matching periods. Record leakage and salinity-flushing water separately and reconcile external meters item by item instead of equating nominal reuse with actual savings across the entire watershed.

Track level during known-head intervals without deliberate exchange, accounting for rain, evaporation and measurement bias before inferring leakage. Compare several heads and observation lengths rather than assigning the entire daily deficit to one unverified valve defect.
pitfalls: 把浮船排水量在每次升降再扣一次會低估用水，忽略曲面閘牆則可能錯估面積。模型看似守恆仍可能因控制範圍漏掉廊道而與量測持續不符。
把回用水量當成完全回收位能會高估節能，忽略靜止端點也會漏計尚存的動能。兩池採不同高程原點時，計算甚至會產生沒有物理意義的能量增益。
高水頭短測試被外推整天可能高估損失，水位儀漂移又會假造漏水。若漏水把鹹水帶入另一池，水量問題還會伴隨水質交換而非單純消耗淡水。
初始流量外推會低估等水位時間，誤把閥位百分比當有效面積也會錯估水量。快速變動時壓力和流速不再同步，甚至可能出現準穩態式無法描述的反向流。
兩支儀器接同一錯誤基準時讀值一致仍可能一起錯，重新校零前後的跳變也可能被誤認為節水。將誤差除以樣本數會虛構不合理的庫容精度。
pitfallsEn: Subtracting the full vessel displacement again understates lift water, while nonvertical walls invalidate constant area. An apparently balanced model can still disagree systematically with observations because its chosen boundary omitted culvert storage.

Equating reused volume with recovered potential energy overstates energy savings, and nonresting endpoints retain kinetic energy. Different elevation origins between basins can even create an apparent energy gain with no physical basis.

Extrapolating a brief high-head test over a day may overstate loss, while sensor drift can create fictitious leakage. Leakage into another basin can also transport salt, producing a quality problem beyond simple freshwater consumption.

Extrapolating initial discharge understates equalization time, and valve-position percentage need not equal open-area fraction. During rapid change pressure and velocity lose synchronization and may reverse in ways the quasi-steady expression cannot represent.

Two sensors sharing an incorrect datum can agree while both are wrong, and a recalibration jump may resemble improved saving. Dividing systematic error by sample count invents unwarranted precision in the calculated storage volume.

history.title: 閘室節水池設計
history.text: 船閘節水的發展需要把通航能力與水資源管理一起考量。美國工兵團二〇〇六年水理手冊整理充排水研究與操作經驗，二〇一八年另有廊道閥門水理手冊。巴拿馬主管機關在二〇一六年二月公布阿瓜克拉拉首個節水池蓄水試驗，同年六月擴建運河啟用；阿瓜克拉拉與科科利提供兩個同一計畫內的真實案例。官方所述回用比例是新船閘內的分配，與舊船閘比較另有分母。本課不複製實際控制程序，所有面積和時間皆為原創教學情境。
history.textEn: Lock water saving develops alongside navigation capacity and water-resource management. The2006 USACE hydraulic manual compiles research and operating experience, with separate culvert-valve guidance in2018. Panama announced the first Agua Clara basin filling test in February2016, followed by expanded-canal inauguration that June. Agua Clara and Cocoli provide two real examples within the same program. The owner’s reuse fraction describes allocation within the new locks and has a different denominator from comparison with old locks. No real control sequence is reproduced; all areas and timings are original teaching scenarios.
